name: orbit
description: Orbit: run teams of Claude Code sessions across devices and accounts. This marketplace carries Uplink, the Orbit seat plugin.

plugins.name: orbit
plugins.description: Uplink: makes this Claude Code session an Orbit seat. SessionStart hook (station, seat, version, update notice, pending counts), /orbit-setup, /orbit-send, /orbit-inbox, /orbit-pull, /orbit-status, and the orbit-watch skill. /orbit:orbit-setup installs the orbit CLI (uplink/cli).
